comparison.objective: Pack a sensor in protective packaging, close the carton, and pass a physical drop test.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual packing, contact closure, selection of cushioning, and shock-protective assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly packed sensor survives a 30 cm drop below a 50 g shock threshold and remains stable; detailed pose tolerances are not present in the available body.
comparison.reason: This tests packaging and impact attenuation after release. The candidate instead applies a deliberate localized impact to cause controlled fracture while preventing collateral damage and recovering resulting fragments.
